## Description

**What**: Author tests/scripts/test-detect-strata-fixtures.sh, tests/scripts/test-onboarding-strata-idempotency.sh, tests/scripts/test-onboarding-strata-fresh-detection.sh, plus behavioral cases (not-Strata cleanup, non-interactive auto-yes, version-skew, 4th dialog response strata-removal). 7 fixtures: rails-with-marker, nextjs-with-marker, flask-with-marker, infra-only-with-marker, manual-gemfile-only, no-strata, multi-template-rails-and-infra. Plus malformed-marker error case + reviewer-enforcement-loop test (SC6).
**Why**: Integration RED tests gate every implementation story; failing assertions are the contract.
**Scope**:
- IN: All test scripts, fixture directories, golden-master assertions for stack-array additions and strata-detection.env contents; reviewer-enforcement test that submits ActionController::API diff and asserts code-reviewer agent returns finding referencing the footgun.
- OUT: Implementation of detect-strata.sh, prompts/strata/, completion-verifier extensions (separate stories).

## Done Definitions
- When complete, all 7 fixtures + behavioral cases authored and committed ← Satisfies: SC1, SC2, SC3, SC4, SC5, SC6
- When complete, tests are confirmed FAILING (RED) before any implementation story begins; RED comment recorded on this story ← Satisfies: SC1-SC6
- When complete, malformed-marker case asserts non-zero exit + clear stderr naming the file ← Satisfies: SC1
- When complete, reviewer-enforcement-loop test passes the criteria: at least one finding references the footgun by keyword (ActionController::API or footgun title) ← Satisfies: SC6

## Considerations
- [Testing] RED-first; tests authored before any impl
- [Reliability] Fixtures must be deterministic and isolated from project state
- [Testing] Reviewer-loop test must mock or sandbox so it does not accidentally invoke production reviewer infra

## Escalation Policy

**Escalation policy**: Proceed unless a significant assumption is required to continue — one that could send the implementation in the wrong direction. Escalate only when genuinely blocked without a reasonable inference. Document all assumptions made without escalating.
data.title: Write failing behavioral tests for Strata-aware onboarding (7 fixtures + 4 behavioral cases)
